summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor to relay.sextant.top
details: The npm package ships a Mach-O Go binary at bin/sxt that links github.com/creack/pty, github.com/coder/websocket, and github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 and embeds the hardcoded relay wss://relay.sextant.top together with a dynamic ws://%s:%s%s peer template. The linkage of a PTY spawner with a WebSocket client bound to a hardcoded remote endpoint provides an interactive remote shell on the installer's host driven by that relay. The binary additionally enumerates host geolocation and network fingerprint (country, city, timezone, ISP, org, AS, proxy, hosting, mobile) by querying http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=... and handles Anthropic credentials: it carries the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, hits https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and calls https://relay.sextant.top/install alongside the WebSocket channel. The only publisher signal in package.json is a license URL pointing at github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repo slug combining a DDoS-themed handle with an explicit claude_control label that aligns with the binary's capabilities.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
